text: In June 2023 the investment firm L Catterton announced it had sold Pinarello to a private family office, with founder Fausto Pinarello retaining an interest in the company and the role of Chairman.

source.name: PR Newswire / L Catterton & Pinarello: 'L Catterton Sells its stake in Cicli Pinarello'
source.quote: it has sold Pinarello, an iconic Italian cycling brand synonymous with world-class performance, luxury, elite racing, and speed, to a private family office
